description: Rating-vs-(accuracy, ACPL) dataset from Lichess analysed games (Prompt 5, requirement 3). Evidence for the qualitative-rating decision: see README "How accuracy is computed". Regenerate with scripts/make-rating-dataset.mjs.
source: GET https://lichess.org/api/games/user/{username}?analysed=true&accuracy=true for users thibault, Zhigalko_Sergei, DrNykterstein, opperwezen, lovlas, EricRosen (public analysed games), retrieved 2026-11-01. Filters: variant=standard, rated, >=20 plies, non-provisional rating, analysis accuracy+acpl present.
